# Health.md CLI

> Compact agent index for installing, operating, and integrating the standalone Health.md CLI and portable MCP server.

The standalone CLI is a public preview for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Health data is read on the paired phone and transferred directly to the requesting computer. Health.md does not provide a health-data cloud. Follow the linked Markdown sources for authoritative prose and examples.

## Start here

- [CLI overview](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli/index.md): availability, supported surfaces, and the shortest successful path.
- [Installation](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli/installation/index.md): Homebrew, signed Mac helpers, release installers, Cargo, upgrades, and verification.
- [Direct phone CLI](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli-direct/index.md): pairing, Manual IP or Tailscale transport, platform boundaries, and troubleshooting.
- [Canonical extraction](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli-extract/index.md): selected canonical iPhone data and output guarantees.
- [Durable jobs](https://healthmd.app/docs/cli-jobs/index.md): status, interruption, resume, cancellation, and partial results.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Portable MCP tool catalog](https://healthmd.app/agents/mcp/portable-tools-v1.json): exact published tool names and JSON Schemas.
- [CLI skill manifest](https://healthmd.app/agents/skills/healthmd-cli/manifest.json): latest and immutable versioned skill artifacts with checksums.
- [Agent asset manifest](https://healthmd.app/agents/manifest.json): availability, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes.
- [Reference provenance manifest](https://healthmd.app/docs/reference/source-manifest.json): content-addressed source and generation evidence.

## Operating rules

- Treat public-preview boundaries and platform differences as authoritative; do not infer unsupported parity.
- Use `healthmd status` before a health-data request and preserve returned job UUIDs.
- Prefer bounded dates and metric scopes. Report units, coverage, missingness, and limitations.
- Do not diagnose, recommend treatment, or infer causation from exported health data.
- Do not send health values, requested scope, or results through an unrelated cloud service.
